items.headline: FM Sitharaman ready to hear out stock market tax debate
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman expressed interest in the discussions surrounding stock investment taxes and their implications. She mentioned that changes to these taxes are highly anticipated ahead of the Union Budget.

items.headline: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.summary: * Chairman and Chief Executive Officer - James Dimon * Chief Financial Officer - Jeremy Barnum TAKEAWAYS * Net Income -- $15.3 billion, representing a 6% increase compared to the previous year. * Diluted Earnings Per Share -- $5.57, rising 10% year over year from $5.07.
